'''Cherith base'''<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> was a secret [[Empire of the Hand]] military base located on an [[Unidentified inhospitable world|inhospitable world]] that was maintained by the [[Empire of the Hand]]<ref name="DJ" /> by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> It was one of many secret military bases established by the [[Baron of the Empire/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]. The base shared its name with<ref name="DJ" /> [[Cherith Fel]], daughter of Soontir and [[Syal Antilles Fel]].<ref name="DTII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>
